card.name: Digits just before a number like 120, 180
card.fires_on: The spot right before or at the start of a number's leading digits where the next digits are likely 2 or 8 (such as 1|20, 1|28, 1|80), mostly in dose figures and sizes.

modes.label: Split dose numbers
modes.description: The first digit or the gap before a dose number whose next digits continue it, such as 120 or 180 mg.

modes.label: Space or symbol before a dose
modes.description: A space, parenthesis or 'to' just before a dose number such as 8, 16 or 32 mg.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of four- and sixteen-type number words, with a slight lift to 'three' words, so it steers number choice only weakly.
card.plain: It fires at the start of a dose or size figure, just before the following digits of numbers like 120 or 180 are written.
